concerns.quote: The medical condition of the deceased was known. He was known to have suffered blackouts and was also in addition to a car driving licence, the holder of an HGV licence. The deceased had informed his own GP that he was no longer driving and had notified DVLA. Neither appear to have been correct. Additionally, in order to renew his HGV licence, the deceased completed a form DP4 on the 19 August 2024 which was accompanied by a Medical examination report of the same date.
concerns.hazard: driver providing inaccurate information to DVLA and independent GP

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the problem that drivers may fail to disclose relevant medical conditions to the DVLA, relying on self‑reporting without adequate verification. The earlier report focuses on the use of independent GPs who cannot check the information, while the later report stresses the general requirement for self‑notification and its ineffective enforcement.
